sections.text_helper: Section 37.5.2 "High-resolution parallel camera and DCMIPP" in chapter 37 (Camera subsystem), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1789.
sections.section_content:
This is the default use case to grab a picture from a parallel camera (up to the target
5Mpixels @30fps). Any RGB or RawBayer picture can be grabbed.
The steps to setup this path are the following:
• Clock and reset:
– pixck_pdck_cci is provided by the sensor (via the PCB on the input I/O,
120MHzmax). Each pixel needs 1 to 3 cycles to get in.
– ck_icn_p_dcmipp is provided by the RCC for the DCMIPP configuration
(default200MHz).
– ck_ker_csi2 is provided by the RCC for the pixel pipelines of the DCMIPP
(default200 MHz).
– ck_icn_m_dcmipp is provided by the RCC for the DCMIPP AXI (default400MHz).
– Section20: Reset and clock control (RCC) provides the needed details.
• DCMIPP configuration:
– Select the parallel interface as input interface.
– Setup the DCMIPP (parallel interface, ISP, application path, AXI-plug) as
described in Section39: Digital camera interface pixel pipeline (DCMIPP).
